Position Summary
We are seeking a Senior HR Executive to join Aurora Systems, a fast-growing enterprise software company headquartered in Bengaluru. This role will sit within a centralized HR Shared Services and Talent Acquisition team and will partner closely with engineering, product, and corporate functions. The Senior HR Executive will manage full-cycle recruitment for mid- to senior-level technical and corporate roles, drive onboarding and early employee experience initiatives, and act as a point of contact for HR systems and hiring process improvements. The position requires a hands-on practitioner who can balance tactical execution with stakeholder management and process optimization in a high-volume, high-quality hiring environment.

Key Responsibilities

Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Operations
- Lead end-to-end Recruitment activities for assigned business units: role intake, sourcing strategy, candidate screening, scheduling, interviewing coordination, offer management, and closure.
- Use Workday or LinkedIn Recruiter to source, track, and manage candidate pipelines; ensure accurate and timely updates to candidate records and requisitions.
- Build and maintain talent pools for critical skills and future hiring needs; proactively engage passive candidates and develop referral channels.
- Partner with hiring managers to define role profiles, competency frameworks, and interview scorecards; coach managers on interview best practices and selection decisions.
- Manage candidate experience, ensuring timely communication, strong employer branding, and high-touch coordination from offer to joining.

Onboarding and Early Employee Experience
- Design and execute onboarding plans for new hires in collaboration with HR Ops, IT, and Facilities to ensure seamless first 90 days.
- Coordinate pre-boarding activities, document collection, compliance checks, and induction sessions.
- Monitor early tenure metrics and partner with managers on retention interventions for critical hires.

HR Systems, Reporting and Process Improvement
- Maintain accurate recruitment and candidate data in Workday or LinkedIn Recruiter; generate regular recruitment metrics and dashboards for leadership.
- Identify process bottlenecks and lead initiatives to improve time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and hiring efficiency.
- Ensure recruitment processes comply with internal policies and local statutory requirements.

Stakeholder Management and Employer Branding
- Act as the primary HR business partner for assigned departments, building credibility through consultative support.
- Work with Employer Brand and Marketing teams on campus and social recruiting campaigns, events, and targeted outreach.
- Represent HR in cross-functional forums related to workforce planning and talent initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 5-8 years

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Recruitment
- Workday or LinkedIn Recruiter

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-Have)
- Payroll
- Talent Acquisition
- Experience working in a technology product or SaaS company.
- Familiarity with campus recruiting programs and diversity hiring initiatives.
- Strong experience with recruitment metrics, ATS reporting, and stakeholder-driven hiring processes.

Success Metrics
- Time-to-fill and time-to-offer for assigned requisitions meet or exceed quarterly targets.
- Offer acceptance rate and new hire onboarding satisfaction scores reach defined targets.
- Quality-of-hire indicators (performance at 6 months, hiring manager satisfaction) demonstrate improvement year-over-year.
- Accurate and timely candidate data maintenance in HR systems with minimal reconciliation issues.
- Reduction in process-related bottlenecks and demonstrable improvements in recruitment workflow efficiency within first 6 months.

Location and Work Mode
Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
